# THE NINTH — Timing Validation: 50-athlete event

**Generated by** `node docs/race/scripts/timing-validation.mjs` (no dependencies). The script builds the schedule from the timing model in [01-schema-and-timing-model.md §2](01-schema-and-timing-model.md#2-timing-model), then independently asserts every invariant below. **Result: ALL PASS.**

Parameters: work 3:00 · transition 0:30 · start interval 3:30 · heat gap 10:00 **measured from the last athlete's start** · first athlete 60 s after START EVENT · slot binding 60 s before start · voice at −10 s · check-in closes 15:00 before heat start.

Times are **race time**: 0:00:00 = START EVENT, pauses excluded. The wall-clock column assumes START EVENT at 09:00:00 with no pause. A pause of *p* shifts every later wall-clock time by *p*; no race time changes.

## Invariants checked

| # | Invariant | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Interval = work + transition (3:30 = 3:00 + 0:30) | ✅ |
| 2 | Every athlete: 9 × 3:00 work, 8 × 0:30 transition, total exactly 31:00 | ✅ 50/50 |
| 3 | Consecutive starts within a heat exactly 3:30 apart | ✅ |
| 4 | Full heat: last athlete starts at heat start + 28:00 | ✅ 5/5 |
| 5 | Next heat start = last athlete start + 10:00 | ✅ 5/5 |
| 6 | No two athletes ever share a station at the same time; minimum changeover ≥ 0:30 on all 9 stations | ✅ min 30 s |
| 7 | Changeover at a heat boundary = 10:00 − 3:00 | ✅ 7:00 |
| 8 | Peak athletes on course ≤ 9 stations | ✅ peak 9 |
| 9 | Voice (−10 s) ≤ binding (−60 s) ≤ first-start offset (60 s); no binding before START EVENT | ✅ |
